stage: Secondary external clock, registered from the availability inventory before seeing any QDrone estimator errors. Does not replace the fixed T=25 s primary.
cohort: All ten initially eligible external QDrone TWR flights. No selection by GT speed or estimate magnitude. Log every unavailable GT window.
return_clock: Midpoint of common raw source IMU and TWR time support: (max(first IMU,first range) + min(last IMU,last range))/2.
reason: The source contains multi-minute recordings and sometimes begins well before independent prism tracking; fixed T=25 tests an early part. The midpoint is a result-blind second operating condition. No shifting the time to fit the prism coverage.
unchanged: Native noise, initialization, masks, branch constants, raw anchor identity, GT separation, sensor eligibility, lever assumptions and scoring support policy are unchanged.
